result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The two answers are almost identical. Each shows light, dark and high-contrast versions of the same screen side by side, with a faithful light theme, a softened dark palette (dark grey surfaces, lighter green and coral amounts) and a high-contrast theme with white borders, thicker dividers and a bright green button. Both use +/− signs on amounts. A's page says that each theme only changes tokens defined in one place, and B adds a small up-arrow icon to the monthly change, but neither difference is enough to pick a winner. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers show the same three-theme layout with nearly identical palettes. Each has a white light theme using the specified green and red, a thoughtfully lifted dark theme, and a black high-contrast theme with white borders and dividers, a bright button and +/− signs on every amount. A adds a small triangle icon to the monthly gain, and B adds a caption saying the themes are built from shared tokens. Neither difference is enough to pick one over the other. Item 2 is scored from the screenshots alone, because neither answer's CSS could be inspected.
